quotes: Over the past week, the South Ukraine Nuclear Power Plant (NPP) reported detecting 28 drones, some as close as three kilometres from the site.
The Chornobyl facility reported detecting 17 drones while the Rivne NPP reported detecting three drones.
The Khmelnytskyy NPP also reported detecting a drone six kilometres from the site, and the IAEA team there took shelter on Wednesday afternoon.
It was the 26th time during the conflict that the nuclear power plant has lost off-site power, highlighting the extremely fragile nuclear safety and security situation at the site.
